question: Will UNRWA win the Nobel Peace Prize in 2026?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize, as announced by the Norwegian Nobel Committee.

If multiple listed individuals or entities jointly receive the prize, the market will resolve to a single winner. If Donald Trump, Volodymyr Zelenskyy,  Benjamin Netanyahu, Vladimir Putin, or Elon Musk are among the recipients, the market will resolve to the highest-ranked among them in that exact order of precedence. If none of those five are among the winners and the prize is awarded jointly to at least one listed individual and at least one listed organization, the market will resolve in favor of the individual. If no prioritized individuals are among the winners and all listed recipients are of the same type (all individuals or all organizations), the market will resolve to the person whose last name, or the entity’s name, comes first in alphabetical order as listed in this market.

If no official announcement regarding the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize has been made by March 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other."

The resolution source for this market will be the first official announcement from the Norwegian Nobel Committee.

# Research report 1 of 2

# UNRWA and the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize: research as of 2026-09-23

Most page fetches failed through the proxy, so this summary relies mainly on search-result snippets.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026 (Committee press release, early 2026): there are 287 nominated candidates, 208 individuals and 79 organizations. The Committee keeps names secret for 50 years. [nobelpeaceprize.org](https://www.nobelpeaceprize.org/press/press-releases/nominations-for-the-nobel-peace-prize-2026)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. I found **no public evidence of a 2026 nomination of UNRWA**. The only documented nomination I found is from 2024-02, by Norwegian Labour MP Åsmund Aukrust. [JNS](https://www.jns.org/unrwa-nominated-for-nobel-peace-prize/), [Israel Hayom](https://www.israelhayom.com/2024/02/02/norwegian-mp-proposes-unrwa-for-nobel-peace-prize-amid-global-criticism/)
- An organization can still win without its nomination being made public, so this absence is not conclusive.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-25: UNRWA said it was "profoundly perturbed" by Israeli forces storming its Qalandiya Training Centre in Jerusalem. [Libnanews/QNA](https://live.libnanews.com/event/ev-1787690224009-a903)
- 2026-07-21: UNRWA reopened Beach Camp Health Centre in Gaza City. It had been closed since being damaged in the Sept-Oct 2025 escalation. [ReliefWeb](https://reliefweb.int/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/unrwa-occupied-palestinian-territory-flash-appeal-2026)
- 2026-03-18: PRIO Director Nina Græger published her 2026 shortlist. It did **not** include UNRWA. The names were Sudan's Emergency Response Rooms; Mykola Kuleba and Save the Children; the Committee to Protect Journalists; the ICJ and ICC; and the International Space Station. [PRIO](https://www.prio.org/news/3693)
- 2026-03: The Commissioner-General warned that the agency's ability to keep operating was in doubt because of a funding crisis. [Libnanews](https://live.libnanews.com/event/ev-1774016000666-5f01)
- 2026-01: Israel demolished UNRWA's East Jerusalem headquarters, and the UN condemned it. [ReliefWeb](https://reliefweb.int/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/unrwa-occupied-palestinian-territory-flash-appeal-2026)
- 2024-02: When UNRWA was nominated, a PRIO director said a prize for the agency would be controversial because of Israel's claims that some of its staff took part in the Oct 7 attack. [TBS News](https://www.tbsnews.net/world/nobel-peace-prize-could-honour-unrwa-icj-un-chief-guterres-957216)

## 4. Base rates
- UN bodies have won several times: UNHCR (1954, 1981), UNICEF (1965), UN Peacekeeping (1988), IAEA (2005), WFP (2020), the UN and Kofi Annan (2001), and IPCC (2007). Each year, one candidate wins out of roughly 250 to 350 nominees.
- UNRWA was a widely discussed candidate, including on PRIO's list, in 2024 and was talked about again in 2025. It did not win either year (2024: Nihon Hidankyo; 2025: María Corina Machado). [TBS News](https://www.tbsnews.net/world/nobel-peace-prize-could-honour-unrwa-icj-un-chief-guterres-957216)
- PRIO directors' lists from 2014 to 2025 included about 10 eventual winners. UNRWA is not on the 2026 list. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PRIO_Director%27s_Shortlist)

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-09-10: Polymarket (via CryptoSlate sync) had Yulia Navalnaya at 7.5%, the International Court of Justice at 5.7% and **UNRWA at 5.3%**, so UNRWA was among the top few in a very fragmented field. [CryptoSlate](https://cryptoslate.com/predictions/market/nobel-peace-prize-winner-2026/)
- 2026-08-25: Kalshi's last trade for **UNRWA was 4¢**. An expert panel convened on 2026-08-23 put UNRWA's median probability at 5%. [OddsShopper](https://www.oddsshopper.com/articles/prediction-markets/nobel-peace-prize-2026-model-verdict?mp=mid-a3)
- Late summer 2026 (exact date unclear): Sudan's Emergency Response Rooms led Kalshi at about 15 to 19¢. [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/news/nobel-peace-prize-winner-odds-2026-favorites-pope-leo-xiv-elon-musk-trump-prediction-markets), [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/canada-carney-higher-nobel-peace-odds-trump-12528524)
- An undated Accrue/Polymarket mirror showed UNRWA "Yes" at about 8%, and an undated Sigma article showed UNRWA at 9% on Polymarket. Both are of uncertain timing. [Accrue](https://accrue.com/m/will-unrwa-win-the-nobel-peace-prize-in-2026-983), [Orrery](https://www.orrery.me/markets/will-unrwa-win-the-nobel-peace-prize-in-2026-983), [Sigma](https://sigma.world/zh-hant/news/trump-leads-nobel-peace-prize-odds-in-prediction-markets/)
- I could not find a Manifold price or a September 2026 Kalshi price for UNRWA.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Possible updates to PRIO's shortlist and other expert lists in late September and early October. These shortlists often move markets.
- The UN General Assembly session in late September could raise UNRWA's profile, including any debate on its mandate or funding (its money was reported as running thin).
- Developments in Gaza and the West Bank that affect UNRWA.
- On the resolution rules: if UNRWA shares the prize with any individual, or with Trump, Zelenskyy, Netanyahu, Putin or Musk, the market resolves to that other winner. If it shares only with other organizations, the alphabetical rule applies. A shared win therefore may not resolve to UNRWA.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

I could find only one forecast-type figure for UNRWA, Polymarket at about 4% to 8%, and nothing has already settled the question. Most page fetches were blocked by the proxy, so several figures below come from search-result summaries of those pages rather than the pages themselves. I excluded anything published after 2026-09-23.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question is settled by the first official announcement from the Norwegian Nobel Committee (nobelprize.org). I could not fetch that site, so I have no direct status reading from it.
- Resolution quirk: if UNRWA wins jointly with an individual on the market's list, the market resolves to the individual. If it wins jointly with another listed organization, it resolves to whichever name comes first alphabetically.

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-09-23, nothing settles the question. The laureate had not been announced.
- I found no public confirmation that UNRWA was nominated for 2026. Nominators may disclose their own nominations, but the committee keeps the list secret for 50 years. [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2641879)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-25: UNRWA condemned Israeli forces entering its Qalandiya Training Centre in Jerusalem. [Libnanews](https://live.libnanews.com/event/ev-1787690224009-a903)
- Late July 2026: In Gaza, UNRWA started summer learning for more than 39,500 children (July 18) and reopened the Beach Camp Health Centre (July 21). The same update said fighting in Gaza had escalated significantly. [Libnanews](https://live.libnanews.com/event/ev-1785420537808-5dce)
- 2026-04-30: The committee logged 287 nominations: 208 individuals and 79 organizations. Leaders of Cambodia, Israel and Pakistan said they had nominated Trump, and a Norwegian newspaper reported Zelenskyy was nominated. [Euromaidan Press](https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/04/30/norwegian-nobel-committee-logs-287-nominations-for-2026-peace-prize-trump-and-zelenskyy-among-the-nominees/)
- 2026-03-18: PRIO director Nina Græger published her personal 2026 shortlist. I could not get the names, so I can't say whether UNRWA is on it. [PRIO](https://prio.org/research/topics/nobel-peace-prize)
- March 2026: Commissioner-General Philippe Lazzarini warned that UNRWA's continued operation was in doubt because of a funding crisis. [Libnanews](https://live.libnanews.com/event/ev-1774016000666-5f01)
- 2026-01-20: Israeli forces demolished UNRWA's East Jerusalem headquarters, and the UN condemned it. UNRWA's 2026 flash appeal for the occupied Palestinian territory seeks US$1.26 billion. [ReliefWeb](https://reliefweb.int/report/occupied-palestinian-territory/unrwa-occupied-palestinian-territory-flash-appeal-2026)
- Separately, a headline says UNRWA had "funds until end of September." I couldn't open the article to confirm its date. [The Sun MY](https://thesun.my/news/world-news/un-agency-for-palestinians-says-has-funds-until-end-of-september-af12717236/)

## 4. Base rates
- UNRWA has never won. Its only publicly confirmed nomination I found was in February 2024, by Norwegian Labour MP Åsmund Aukrust. [Israel Hayom](https://www.israelhayom.com/2024/02/02/norwegian-mp-proposes-unrwa-for-nobel-peace-prize-amid-global-criticism/), [JNS](https://www.jns.org/unrwa-nominated-for-nobel-peace-prize/)
- In 2024, media and bookmakers listed UNRWA as a possible winner alongside the ICJ and UN Secretary-General Guterres. The 2024 prize went to Nihon Hidankyo. [TBS News](https://www.tbsnews.net/world/nobel-peace-prize-could-honour-unrwa-icj-un-chief-guterres-957216)
- The 2025 prize went to María Corina Machado. [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2641879)
- From my background knowledge (not sourced here): UN bodies have won several times, including UNHCR (1954, 1981), UNICEF (1965), UN Peacekeeping (1988), the UN and Kofi Annan (2001), the IAEA (2005) and the WFP (2020). That is roughly one UN-agency win per decade. Pre-announcement favorites, especially in betting markets, have often lost.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-09-10: A Polymarket snapshot shown on CryptoSlate had **UNRWA at 5.3%**, behind Yulia Navalnaya (7.5%) and the International Court of Justice (5.7%), with Zelenskyy at 2.9%. [CryptoSlate](https://cryptoslate.com/predictions/market/nobel-peace-prize-winner-2026/)
- Other Polymarket snapshots (dates unclear) put UNRWA at about 4.3% to 4.9%, and an aggregator showed about 8%. [Accrue](https://accrue.com/m/will-unrwa-win-the-nobel-peace-prize-in-2026-983), [Octagon](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/awards/politics/nobel-peace-prize-winner-2026/), [Orrery](https://www.orrery.me/markets/will-unrwa-win-the-nobel-peace-prize-in-2026-983)
- A UK bookmaker reportedly listed UNRWA at 8/1, about 11% implied before the bookmaker's margin. I could not open the page to check its date. [Casino.org](https://www.casino.org/news/nobel-peace-prize-odds-predictions/)
- Early-season coverage had Trump leading the betting. [OLBG](https://www.olbg.com/news/nobel-peace-prize-2026-odds-donald-trump-leads-early-betting-market)
- I did not find a Kalshi or Manifold price specifically for UNRWA.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Late September to early October: the PRIO shortlist and newspaper "favorite" lists are usually updated or publicized. Market prices can swing sharply in the final hours if information leaks, as happened in 2025.
- Ongoing: UNRWA's funding cliff around the end of September, Israeli restrictions on the agency, and Gaza hostilities could raise or lower the committee's interest in a humanitarian or UN-system laureate.

on 2026-08-25.
- An expert panel gave a 5% median on 2026-08-23.
- Humanitarian salience is high: the East Jerusalem HQ was demolished in January 2026, there was a funding crisis in March 2026, and Gaza operations continue (July 2026).
- The Committee has a track record of rewarding UN agencies, including WFP in 2020.

Evidence for No:
- PRIO's 2026 shortlist, published 2026-03-18, omits UNRWA.
- I found no confirmed 2026 nomination; the only documented one is from 2024.
- The agency remains politically controversial because of Israel's Oct 7 staff allegations.
- It lost as a discussed candidate in both 2024 and 2025.
- The joint-award resolution rules shave off some probability.

(e) No scenario: the Committee picks Sudan's Emergency Response Rooms, a press-freedom group, the ICJ, Navalnaya or someone else, in line with its recent preference for less-predicted laureates. Yes scenario: the Committee wants to make a statement on Gaza and on the multilateral humanitarian system under attack. It awards UNRWA alone, perhaps citing the funding collapse and the attacks on its facilities.

(f) I start from a reference rate of about 4% and anchor to the market range of 4 to 5.3%. Prize markets tend to overprice salient, politically popular names. UNRWA's absence from PRIO's list and the resolution-rule leakage from joint awards both nudge the estimate down slightly. Its continued prominence keeps it from falling much below the market. I end slightly under the market.

Probability: 4%
